evidence: Actual Maven candidate from Contracts commit 76a3e0d39e61c7868b497ae7e059e29ac69f44de, version 1.0.0-ci.46.1, inspected 2026-09-19. These copied Javadoc resources carry Oracle copyright and GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 headers. The artifact also carries legal/LICENSE and legal/ADDITIONAL_LICENSE_INFO. The current Apache boundary prohibits GPL-family implementation material; a legal-document retention permission does not admit these scripts. Exact member hashes are retained in the WP00.03 published-documentation-audit receipt.
requiredDecision: Replace the copied Javadoc implementation resources using a compatible, fully audited documentation producer while preserving complete API documentation and immutable package identities. Do not introduce a licensing exception or republish the old version.
resolution: 2026-09-19: under D-004, D-013 and Design 1d2a2aa800bc93b26d12337e669bdcf3fd85150f section 3.2, replace the fixture Javadoc producer with the already pinned Dokka 2.2.0 producer. New record dokka-documentation-resources-r1 admits only the audited Apache/MIT resources, preserves complete API pages, navigation and search, removes ten OFL font files and exactly four font-face declarations, and retains full notices for 81 actual emitted npm components (including nested style-loader 3.3.4 and css-loader 6.11.0). All four real quarantined replacement JARs passed the closed member, source, licence, notice and API-content checks before this conflict was resolved; local bundle SHA-256 6f25c89e175804f49fdff693400d6e4aeea39dcaa6a1432417f5bff73f95e048, inspected base 76a3e0d39e61c7868b497ae7e059e29ac69f44de with uncommitted WP00.03 changes and version 1.0.0-ci.0.0. This local audit is not publication evidence. The same gate must pass on the final CI candidate and every publisher; candidate-specific identities and member hashes are retained in documentation-provenance.json. Existing published versions remain immutable. No licensing exception or API removal is authorized.
